value.rationale: The source's central finite example distinguishes affine normals by ordinary minimum distance and uses the outside condition as the optimal choice. Generalized Hamming weights are the standard higher-dimensional refinement of minimum distance. Showing that every one of the 1764 optimal-normal realizations shares not only the same hierarchy but the complete subcode-support spectrum demonstrates that the source's optimality class is substantially more rigid than its ordinary weight enumerator reveals. The result is a natural exact invariant of a newly published construction rather than an arbitrary slice.
